findings.issue: Sense-changing mistranslation: いる is glossed as 'lively' (apparent confusion of 'animate' with 'animated/lively'). The sentence just says he is/exists at home.
findings.suggested: As for him, at home (he) is/exists.

findings.issue: '(ser animado)' wrongly glosses いる as 'to be lively/animated'. いる means existir/estar (usado para seres animados); the parenthetical teaches a false meaning.
findings.current: Quanto a ele / em casa / estar (ser animado).
findings.suggested: Quanto a ele, em casa está (existe).
